title: Name the five suite-level Windows skips after their reason
notes: workflow-rule-6 now says never a bare it.skipIf with its reason in a comment, but five suites still skip with a bare describe.skipIf(process.platform === 'win32'), four with no reason: src/main/app/shell-path.test.ts:11, src/main/update/install.test.ts:69, src/main/panes/host-socket.test.ts:8, src/main/processes/launch-scopes.test.ts:8, src/main/workers/screen-host.test.ts:75. Cost: nobody can tell whether a suite could now run on Windows without rediscovering why it skips, and new suites copy the bare form. Fix: suite-level named skips in src/main/testing/windows-skips.ts, one per reason, plus a line in workflow-rule-6. Issue: https://github.com/naeemba/dashboard/issues/389 Review: https://github.com/naeemba/dashboard/pull/388#discussion_r4706819053
